children: On August 6, 2026, Nasdaq staff issued a determination to delist the company for failing to meet the $50 million Market Value of Listed Securities requirement, with additional notices on August 12 for minimum publicly held market value and on August 27 for a late Form 10-Q. The company requested a hearing on September 15, 2026, which stays any suspension, and it is seeking to transfer its listing to The Nasdaq Capital Market; following an October 9, 2026 transaction closing, the company believes it meets the $2.5 million stockholders’ equity requirement and awaits the Hearings Panel’s decision.
